scope: Full current quarantine process-death and maintenance effect inspection tests
assessment: Actual owned SIGKILL at intent, move and receipt during commit/restore reports COMMIT_STARTED/RESTORING and recovers through public CLI
Independent active artifact remains valid and original copy can be restored after recovery
Maintenance observation checks actual bytes independently of saved outcome and preserves JSON records
Plans report NOT_EXECUTED; fixture purge reappearance reports FAIL while retaining owner bytes
CLI and HTTP match core and reject workspace overrides
limitations: HTTP inspection test title mentions restart but only one server context asserted
Readonly preservation compares JSON records rather than all media files
Disposable single-filesystem fixtures and selected kill boundaries; real products, cross-volume and browser separate
Any purge deletes only disposable test media, not product assets
